# GeeTest bootstrap assets

These two files are unmodified local copies of GeeTest's official Web bootstrap scripts. Their source URLs and
SHA-256 values are recorded in the repository root `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

The bootstrap file is local; a real CAPTCHA still loads remote GeeTest resources and is completed by a person.
Use `npm run build:mock` when testing this repository without a real upstream challenge.
